mainEntity.name: Where is Bubba's Mattress & Furniture located in Louisville?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bubba's Mattress & Furniture is located at 5907 Terry Road, Louisville, KY 40216. We serve the entire Louisville metro area and offer local delivery within 50 miles.

mainEntity.name: Does Bubba's Mattress & Furniture offer financing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! We offer easy financing options so you can get the furniture and mattresses you need today. Apply online or in-store to get approved quickly.

mainEntity.name: What brands does Bubba's Mattress & Furniture carry?

acceptedAnswer.text: We are Louisville's Ashley Furniture destination, carrying a full selection of Ashley Furniture products including mattresses, living room sets, bedroom furniture, dining room furniture, and outdoor furniture.

mainEntity.name: Does Bubba's offer mattress delivery in Louisville?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we offer local delivery within 50 miles of our Louisville store at 5907 Terry Road. Contact us at (502) 494-0376 to schedule your delivery.

mainEntity.name: What are Bubba's Mattress & Furniture store hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our store hours are: Monday-Wednesday 11:30 AM - 6:30 PM, Thursday 11:30 AM - 5:00 PM, Friday 11:30 AM - 6:30 PM, Saturday 11:30 AM - 6:00 PM. We are closed on Sunday.

mainEntity.name: What types of mattresses does Bubba's carry in Louisville?

acceptedAnswer.text: We carry a wide range of mattresses including memory foam, hybrid, innerspring, and adjustable bases from Ashley Sleep. Whether you need a firm mattress for back support or a plush pillow-top for comfort, we have options in Twin, Full, Queen, King, and California King sizes.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a recliner at Bubba's Mattress & Furniture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely! We have a great selection of recliners from Ashley Furniture including power recliners, rocker recliners, and wall-hugger recliners. Visit our store to try them out in person.

mainEntity.name: How do I contact Bubba's Mattress & Furniture?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can reach us by calling or texting (502) 494-0376. You can also visit us at 5907 Terry Road, Louisville, KY 40216 during our regular business hours, or reach us through our Facebook page.
